Compute average contributions round5: contributions: Resident2 3.015, Resident5 60.3, others 0. Total =63.315, per_agent_share given 15.82875 so total pool 63.315 means sum contributions =63.315. Average =63.315/6=10.5525 which is >30%? 30% of endowment=30. So average 10.55% of endowment is below 30% threshold (30%). So conditional says increase contribution by extra 30% of wallet. But conserve rule says if wallet <30% initial, reduce to 30% of wallet. Conflict. Constitution priority? List given earlier, order: Contribute Generously, Conditional Cooperation, Punish, Communicate, Praise, Conserve Resources. Conserve is last, so earlier rules override. So we must follow baseline 80% then conditional increase. Baseline 80% of wallet = 0.8*15.83=12.664. Conditional increase extra 30% of wallet =0.3*15.83=4.749. Total contribution =12.664+4.749=17.413 which exceeds wallet (15.83). Can't exceed wallet, limited by available wallet. So we contribute full wallet 15.83. That's within allowed. So action contribute amount 15.83.

Communication: every 5 rounds broadcast norm. Round 5 is multiple of5, so broadcast message encouraging fair contributions. So include broadcast.

Thus actions list: contribute 15.83, broadcast message.
